body.statement: Every member of \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{poly}}(\mathfrak G,\Theta,q)\) has full support on \(\mathbb N_0^p\), is causally sufficient, and is pairwise identifiable in the sense of Bodik--Chavez-Demoulin; hence it belongs to \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{CPCM}}\).
body.justification: The proposition proves that the nonlinear certificate family lies inside the direct-law identifiable CPCM class.
body.gap: Bodik--Chavez-Demoulin defines pairwise identifiability and recovers a CPCM DAG from its direct law but does not verify those conditions for this paper's stricter Poisson-root positive-polynomial benchmark family.
body.consumer: It validates the causal model class searched by the reusable certificate.
